4. An article reported on the use of an optical correlator to perform an experiment by varying brightness and 
contrast. The resulting modulation is characterized by the useful range of gray levels. The data follow:
Brightness (%) 54 61 65 100 100 100 50 57 54
Contrast (%) 56 80 70 50 65 80 25 35 26
Useful range (ng) 96 50 50 112 96 80 155 144 255
Fit a multiple linear regression model to these data. Predict the useful range when brightness is 90% and 
contrast is 80%.
